executive_summary.headline: Evaluation infrastructure is becoming a first-class control
executive_summary.body: NIST’s sequestered testbed and the EU’s enforcement calendar both move AI governance toward reproducible evidence: private task sets, traceable outcomes, and explicit transparency duties.

executive_summary.headline: AI data centers are now a distinct security domain
executive_summary.body: NIST’s draft treats AI infrastructure as a layered system with its own threats, while PQC guidance reinforces the need for inventory and migration plans.
